question: which five children showed the biggest jump in situp count between the first and second fitness test
gold_sql: SELECT b."Child Name", e."Sit Ups" - b."Sit Ups" AS situps_improvement FROM sportathon_baseline AS b JOIN sportathon_endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" ORDER BY situps_improvement DESC, b."Child Name" LIMIT 5
sql_duckdb: WITH baseline_situps AS (SELECT "Child ID", "Child Name", "Sit Ups" AS baseline_sit_ups FROM sportathon_baseline), endline_situps AS (SELECT "Child ID", "Child Name", "Sit Ups" AS endline_sit_ups FROM sportathon_endline), situp_jumps AS (SELECT bs."Child ID", bs."Child Name", bs.baseline_sit_ups, el.endline_sit_ups, NULLIF(el.endline_sit_ups - bs.baseline_sit_ups, 0) AS situp_jump FROM baseline_situps AS bs JOIN endline_situps AS el ON bs."Child ID" = el."Child ID" WHERE NOT bs.baseline_sit_ups IS NULL AND NOT el.endline_sit_ups IS NULL) SELECT "Child ID", "Child Name", situp_jump FROM situp_jumps ORDER BY situp_jump DESC LIMIT 5

CURRENT QUESTION:
which five children showed the biggest jump in situp count between the first and second fitness test
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH baseline_situps AS (
    SELECT
        "Child ID",
        "Child Name",
        "Sit Ups" AS baseline_sit_ups
    FROM sportathon_baseline
),
endline_situps AS (
    SELECT
        "Child ID",
        "Child Name",
        "Sit Ups" AS endline_sit_ups
    FROM sportathon_endline
),
situp_jumps AS (
    SELECT
        bs."Child ID",
        bs."Child Name",
        bs.baseline_sit_ups,
        el.endline_sit_ups,
        NULLIF(el.endline_sit_ups - bs.baseline_sit_ups, 0) AS situp_jump
    FROM baseline_situps bs
    JOIN endline_situps el ON bs."Child ID" = el."Child ID"
    WHERE bs.baseline_sit_ups IS NOT NULL
    AND el.endline_sit_ups IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    "Child ID",
    "Child Name",
    situp_jump
FROM situp_jumps
ORDER BY situp_jump DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
